comparison.objective: Saw a true mitre while holding moulding against a mitre-box fence, then clear the work.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece restraint, guided reciprocating tool motion, and tool/workpiece handling.
comparison.success_condition: Specified kerf depth or cut-through at the mark and angle, followed by saw return, workpiece removal, and arm clearance; simulation approximates cutting by stroke rules.
comparison.reason: Guided cutting and workpiece restraint do not exercise granular flow, selective screening, or media recovery.
